speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. Please describe your symptoms in detail, specifically regarding the fatigue, flank pain, and fever you experienced after your recent sinusitis treatment. Have you noticed any changes in your urine color or frequency?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you. Since your fever and flank pain persisted after the sinusitis resolved, were you prescribed specific antibiotics for the sinus infection? Also, have you experienced any burning sensation during urination or passed any cloudy or foul-smelling urine?

speaker: Patient
text: I was first treated with amoxicillin for sinusitis and developed a rash. Then the antibiotic was changed to cephalexin for another week, and the rash went away.

speaker: Doctor
text:
That reaction suggests a possible hypersensitivity to beta-lactams. Given your current symptoms of fever, flank pain, and fatigue, could you tell me if you have noticed blood in your urine, nausea, or decreased urine output? Also, have you had any recent travel or insect bites?

text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Interstitial Nephritis

The presence of binucleated eosinophils in the urine, combined with your history of a rash and fever following amoxicillin and cephalexin use, strongly indicates acute interstitial nephritis. The negative bacterial culture and normal renal ultrasound rule out a standard bacterial pyelonephritis or obstruction.
